A short-channel input pair (L=0.15 um) gives preamp gain of about 5. The cross-coupled pair with tau of about 15 ps regenerates 10 mV to 1.8 V in under 100 ps. The inverters drive CL. Reset is through PMOS switches during the 1 ns low clock phase."}

```python
PARAMS = {
    "W_tail": (4.0, 1.0, 12.0),
    "W_in":   (4.0, 1.0, 12.0),
    "W_nx":   (1.5, 0.5, 6.0),
    "W_px":   (2.0, 0.5, 8.0),
    "W_rst":  (0.84, 0.42, 3.0),
    "W_invn": (1.0, 0.42, 4.0),
    "W_invp": (2.5, 0.84, 10.0),
}

def design(p, lut, spec):
    L = 0.15
    VDD = 1.8
    dv = spec.get("dv", 0.002)
    cl = spec.get("cl", 10e-15)
    vcm = spec.get("vcm", 0.9)

    n = Netlist("vinp vinn clk outp outn vdd vss")
    # tail switch
    n.M("Mtail", "t", "clk", "vss", "vss", "nfet", p["W_tail"], L)
    # input pair
    n.M("M1", "dp", "vinp", "t", "vss", "nfet", p["W_in"], L)
    n.M("M2", "dn", "vinn", "t", "vss", "nfet", p["W_in"], L)
    # cross-coupled latch
    n.M("M3", "on", "op", "dp", "vss", "nfet", p["W_nx"], L)
    n.M("M4", "op", "on", "dn", "vss", "nfet", p["W_nx"], L)
    n.M("M5", "on", "op", "vdd", "vdd", "pfet", p["W_px"], L)
    n.M("M6", "op", "on", "vdd", "vdd", "pfet", p["W_px"], L)
    # reset switches (clk low -> precharge to VDD)
    n.M("MR1", "dp", "clk", "vdd", "vdd", "pfet", p["W_rst"], L)
    n.M("MR2", "dn", "clk", "vdd", "vdd", "pfet", p["W_rst"], L)
    n.M("MR3", "on", "clk", "vdd", "vdd", "pfet", p["W_rst"], L)
    n.M("MR4", "op", "clk", "vdd", "vdd", "pfet", p["W_rst"], L)
    # output inverters: vinp>vinn -> 'on' falls -> outp rises
    n.M("MI1n", "outp", "on", "vss", "vss", "nfet", p["W_invn"], L)
    n.M("MI1p", "outp", "on", "vdd", "vdd", "pfet", p["W_invp"], L)
    n.M("MI2n", "outn", "op", "vss", "vss", "nfet", p["W_invn"], L)
    n.M("MI2p", "outn", "op", "vdd", "vdd", "pfet", p["W_invp"], L)

    # ---------- first-order predictions ----------
    cox = 8.5e-15  # F/um^2 approx (gate cap per area incl. overlap, rough)
    def cg(W): return cox * W * L + 0.3e-15 * W

    # integration phase: input pair at vcm, tail ~ linear
    op_in = lut.op('n', p["W_in"], L, vcm - 0.15, 0.6, 0.15)
    I_half = max(op_in["Id"], 1e-6)
    gm_in = op_in["gm"]
    C_d = cg(p["W_nx"]) + 0.6e-15 * (p["W_in"] + p["W_nx"] + p["W_rst"])
    C_o = (cg(p["W_nx"]) + cg(p["W_px"]) + cg(p["W_invn"]) + cg(p["W_invp"])
           + 0.6e-15 * (p["W_nx"] + p["W_px"] + p["W_rst"]) + 1e-15)
    # integration time: discharge outputs by ~Vth_n through Cd+Co
    t_int = (C_d + C_o) * 0.65 / I_half
    Av = gm_in * t_int / (C_d + C_o)
    Av = max(Av, 2.0)
    # regeneration
    op_nx = lut.op('n', p["W_nx"], L, 0.9, 0.9)
    op_px = lut.op('p', p["W_px"], L, 0.9, 0.9)
    gm_l = op_nx["gm"] + op_px["gm"]
    tau = C_o / max(gm_l, 1e-6)
    t_reg = tau * math.log(VDD / 2 / (Av * dv))
    # output inverter delay
    op_ip = lut.op('p', p["W_invp"], L, VDD, VDD / 2)
    C_out = cl + 0.6e-15 * (p["W_invn"] + p["W_invp"])
    t_inv = C_out * VDD / 2 / max(op_ip["Id"], 1e-6)
    t_clk = 15e-12  # tail turn-on
    delay = t_clk + t_int + t_reg + t_inv

    # energy: all internal nodes recharged each cycle + one output swing + tail node
    C_t = 0.6e-15 * (p["W_tail"] + 2 * p["W_in"])
    C_sw = 2 * C_d + 2 * C_o + C_t + C_out + 1.0 * (cg(p["W_invn"]) + cg(p["W_invp"]))
    energy = C_sw * VDD ** 2 * 1.1  # + short-circuit/crowbar margin

    return n, {"correct": 1, "delay": delay, "energy": energy}
```
